itineraries.summary: Structured 7-day Tuscany road-trip itinerary written in the first person by Adeline Gressin: Pisa and Lucca by train, Florence, then the Chianti valley (SR222), Siena, and San Gimignano with Volterra by car. Named hotel/B&B/agritourismo picks (stay22 booking widgets), restaurants, and transport advice included; page carries 2025/03-dated assets and a 'best ice-cream maker of Italy in 2025' claim, placing it after the 2024-09-17 recency floor.
itineraries.title: Visiter la Toscane en 7 jours : mon itinéraire détaillé
PUERTO PRINCESA ITINERARY + BUDGET TRAVEL GUIDE 2026
itineraries.summary: Creator's 4-day Puerto Princesa guide (creator archive dated Feb 13, 2026): city tour covering the Underground River, weaving center and crocodile farm; Honda Bay island hopping; where to stay across city-center, resort and airport zones; and Manila flight/ferry logistics with sample budgets.

items.name: Puerto Princesa Subterranean River
items.details: Day 1 city-tour anchor: the Underground River, one of the New 7 Wonders of Nature. Page links a Klook UNDERGROUND RIVER TOUR booking button.

items.name: Binuatan Creations
items.location: Bougainville Drive, Rafols St., Santa Monica, Puerto Princesa
items.details: Weaving workshop stop on the city tour; open daily 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM.

items.name: Palawan Wildlife Rescue and Conservation Center
items.details: Crocodile farm/conservation stop on the city tour; open daily 8:00 AM – 4:45 PM.

items.name: Honda Bay island hopping
items.details: Day-trip island hopping from Honda Bay; page links a Klook HONDA BAY ISLAND HOPPING booking button.

items.name: Puerto Princesa Heritage Tour
items.details: Half- or full-day heritage/city tour; page links a Klook booking button and recommends booking in advance.

items.name: Mojo Hostel Palawan
items.details: Budget city-center stay on Rizal Avenue area; page links Klook and Agoda reserve/check-rate buttons.

items.name: Hue Hotels and Resorts Puerto Princesa
items.details: City-center hotel; page links Klook and Agoda reserve/check-rate buttons.

items.name: Daluyon Beach and Mountain Resort
items.details: Award-winning eco-friendly DOT-accredited beach resort; creator stayed here on her last trip. Page links Klook and Agoda reserve/check-rate buttons.

items.name: Manila to Puerto Princesa flight
items.details: Major airlines (Philippine Airlines, Cebu Pacific, AirAsia), ~1h15m. Page links a 12go.asia COMPARE RATES HERE button.

items.name: Airport tricycle to city center
items.details: Best for solo/budget travelers with small luggage; 15–25 minutes to downtown.

items.name: Puerto Princesa to El Nido transfer
items.details: Onward transfer link for travelers continuing to El Nido; page links a Klook BOOK HERE button.

items.name: Philippines 5G SIM / eSIM
items.details: Travel essential listed in the guide; page links Klook BUY HERE buttons for physical SIM and eSIM.

itineraries.title: PUERTO GALERA ITINERARY (TRAVEL GUIDE + BUDGET) 2025
itineraries.summary: Creator's Puerto Galera guide (creator archive dated Aug 13, 2025): 2- and 3-day samples with land tour (Muelle Bay heritage park, Iraya-Mangyan Village, Tamaraw Falls), island-hopping/snorkeling, Batangas Port ferry logistics, and resort picks across White Beach, Aninuan and Sabang.

items.name: Muelle Cultural Heritage Park
items.details: Land-tour stop: Muelle Bay, historical canon, life-size replica of Spanish galleon. Access by tricycle.
items.price_hint: Entrance FREE; tricycle ≈ ₱150 ($3) one way for 3 pax

items.name: Iraya-Mangyan Village
items.details: Indigenous village visit on the land tour; open daily 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM.

items.name: Tamaraw Falls
items.details: Waterfall stop on the land tour; reachable by jeep en route to Calapan or chartered tricycle.

items.name: Puerto Galera island hopping and snorkeling
items.details: Boat day trip with snorkeling; creator used third-party operator NDM Travel Connections (contact 0908 470 7257) as a customer.

items.name: Casa Marco Suites
items.details: White Beach resort; page links RESERVE HERE / CHECK RATES HERE affiliate buttons.

items.name: The Mangyan Grand Hotel
items.details: White Beach hotel; page links RESERVE HERE / CHECK RATES HERE affiliate buttons.

items.name: Simon Heritage Resort
items.details: White Beach resort; page links RESERVE HERE / CHECK RATES HERE affiliate buttons.

items.name: AV Suites
items.details: Aninuan Beach stay (less crowded than White Beach); page links affiliate reserve/check-rate buttons.

items.name: Tamaraw Beach Resort
items.details: Aninuan Beach resort; page links affiliate reserve/check-rate buttons.

items.name: Lalaguna Villas Luxury Dive Resort & Spa
items.details: Dive-oriented Sabang resort (Sabang is the best area for diving); page links affiliate reserve/check-rate buttons.

items.name: Manila to Puerto Galera bus + ferry
items.location: Ermita, Manila → Batangas Port → Puerto Galera
items.details: Bus + ferry ticket departing 9:30 AM from City State Tower Hotel, Ermita; page links Klook RESERVE HERE / KKday BOOK HERE buttons.

items.name: Batangas Port to Puerto Galera fast craft
items.details: Fast craft (MV Island Calayan, Island Water) or RoRo ferry (FastCat, Montenegro Lines) across to Puerto Galera/Calapan.
